D01: Explicit standalone JSON kinds retain immutable exact source text, deduplicate byte/canonical imports, and never create counterfeit character cards.
D02: Typed content saves use immutable CAS history, exact-revision local forks share original source records, and foreign/deleted content stays isolated.
D03: Native sharing pins exact saved revisions; current ancestor visibility/fork policies and versioned policy writes fence shared reads, originals and private recipient forks.
D04: Concurrent imports create one membership, failed writes roll back sources/revisions/import claims, and a policy revoked immediately before private-fork commit creates no recipient content.
